lines: She asked, “Are we leaving now?” I told her the train
had been delayed, but the station café was still open.
We could wait there for a while
and check the departure board together.
“That sounds better,” she said,
picking up the small blue suitcase.
By the time we reached the platform,
the announcement had changed again.
We decided to stay close to the information desk.
